description: The forward closure is closed under the definite rules and is contained in every closed set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure_is_least.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Closed Γ ↑(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Γ) ∧
    ∀ (Y : Set α),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Closed Γ Y →
        ∀ p ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Γ, p ∈ Y
